owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
purpose: Canonical non-destructive production blueprint for RESET creative voice rooms using Discord, MPC Beats, OBS Studio, Elgato Wave Link, and Elgato Camera Hub.

reference_room.eligible_members: cleared members with a creative spark; not music-only

principles: Discord remains functional if OBS, Wave Link, Camera Hub, MPC Beats, or the RMS Discord bridge is unavailable.
Do not change global Windows audio devices solely for one Discord room.
Use dedicated monitor and stream mixes to prevent echo and double monitoring.
Discord receives a clean microphone feed, never the full Stream Mix.
OBS receives the Stream Mix or isolated Wave Link sources, never duplicate copies of the same signal.
Do not route confidential creator audio into public rooms without explicit consent.
Record only when the room and event explicitly disclose recording status.
Creative room invitations are multidisciplinary: music, podcasting, spoken word, visual art, education, gaming, interviews, storytelling, production, and collaboration are all valid uses.

verified_device_names_from_founder_works.discord_current_input_observed: System Default - Stream Mix (Elgato Virtual Audio)

canonical_signal_flow.voice_to_discord: Elgato Wave:3 -> Wave Link microphone processing -> Mic In / MicrophoneFX clean mic bus -> Discord microphone input
canonical_signal_flow.discord_guests_to_host: Discord output -> Wave Link Discord app channel -> Personal Mix -> host headphones
canonical_signal_flow.discord_guests_to_obs: Discord output -> Wave Link Discord app channel -> Stream Mix -> OBS
canonical_signal_flow.mpc_to_host: MPC Beats -> Wave Link MPC app channel -> Personal Mix -> host headphones
canonical_signal_flow.mpc_to_obs: MPC Beats -> Wave Link MPC app channel -> Stream Mix -> OBS
canonical_signal_flow.mpc_to_discord: Do not send MPC into the Discord microphone bus by default. Use Discord screen/application stream audio or an explicitly enabled performance mix only for a declared performance session.
canonical_signal_flow.camera_to_obs: Elgato Facecam MK.2 -> OBS Video Capture Device
canonical_signal_flow.camera_hub_control: Camera Hub may configure the Facecam while OBS owns the active preview. 'Video preview occupied' is expected when OBS has the device open.
canonical_signal_flow.obs_program: Clean mic + Discord guests + approved music/app/game sources -> OBS -> recording / stream / virtual camera as required

discord.preferred_input_device: Mic In (Elgato Wave:3) or Wave Link MicrophoneFX clean microphone bus
never_use_as_microphone_input: Chat Mix (Elgato Virtual Audio) unless explicitly engineered as a clean microphone-only bus
discord.preferred_output_device: Wave Link routed Discord playback bus / approved Elgato virtual output feeding the Discord application channel
discord.echo_cancellation: enabled for general/open voice use; may be disabled only after headphone-only controlled studio testing confirms no loop
discord.noise_suppression: light or disabled when Wave Link processing already supplies gating/noise control
discord.attenuation: 0 percent for production rooms unless host intentionally uses ducking
discord.critical_rule: Discord output must never return into the same bus used as Discord microphone input.

wave_link.microphone_path: Wave:3 -> processing -> clean mic bus -> Discord
wave_link.stream_path: Wave:3 + Discord + MPC + approved app/game/media sources -> Stream Mix -> OBS

recommended_stream_mix.System: ON only when program requires it

avoid: feeding Discord output back into Discord input
routing OBS monitoring back into the Discord microphone bus
capturing both Stream Mix and the same sources again in OBS without intentional isolated-track design

obs.preferred_primary_audio_strategy: Use one Wave Link Stream Mix as the program bus for simplicity, then add isolated sources only when separate recording tracks are required.

simple_blueprint.mic_aux: Stream Mix (Elgato Virtual Audio) OR one Audio Input Capture using Stream Mix, but not both
simple_blueprint.camera_source: Elgato Facecam MK.2 through Video Capture Device
simple_blueprint.duplicate_audio_rule: Each audible source appears exactly once in the program mix

advanced_multitrack_blueprint.track_5: Game / HD60 X isolated when used
advanced_multitrack_blueprint.rule: Isolated tracks are for recording/post only unless explicitly mapped to the stream program.

obs.audio_monitoring: Monitor only sources required by the host. Avoid Monitor and Output on sources already returned through Wave Link.
obs.recording: Use separate audio tracks for microphone, Discord guests, and program audio when the production requires post-production flexibility.

camera_hub.camera_role: Primary host camera for OBS and approved video sessions.
camera_hub.exposure: Lock exposure and white balance after lighting is set for flagship sessions to prevent visible pumping.
camera_hub.picture: Founder-observed contrast/saturation/sharpness settings may remain as the starting preset; validate skin tone and highlights on the actual OBS program feed.
camera_hub.background_apps: OBS should be the device owner during production. Camera Hub showing 'Video preview occupied' while OBS uses the camera is expected.
camera_hub.virtual_camera: Use OBS Virtual Camera for apps that need the fully produced scene rather than competing directly for the Facecam.

mpc_beats.routing: MPC Beats main output -> Wave Link MPC (64-bit) application channel
mpc_beats.discord_performance: For Claim Your Stage or collaborative sessions, prefer Discord application/screen-share audio where practical. If a dedicated performance-return bus is engineered later, it must exclude Discord return audio to prevent feedback.
mpc_beats.sample_rate_rule: Use one consistent production sample rate across Wave Link, OBS, and MPC. Prefer 48 kHz for video/live production unless a verified music workflow requires otherwise.

Reset Main Arena.priority: multipurpose community activation and creator connection

Claim Your Stage.priority: performance, presentation, demo, storytelling, education, interviews, visual-share, creator showcases, and audience interaction
Claim Your Stage.eligibility: cleared members with a creative spark

Game Room.priority: low-latency conversation, gaming, community play, creator social connection, and game-stream collaboration

preflight: Set Discord microphone to Mic In (Elgato Wave:3) or the clean Wave Link microphone-only bus. Do not use Stream Mix as Discord microphone input.
Route Discord playback into the Wave Link Discord application channel and hear it in Personal Mix.
Confirm Wave:3, Discord, and intended MPC/game/app channels are ON in Stream Mix for OBS.
In OBS, capture Stream Mix exactly once and disable any duplicate global/device audio source.
Confirm OBS meters show one clean instance of each intended source.
Confirm Facecam MK.2 is owned by OBS and Camera Hub controls remain available even when its preview is occupied.
Confirm recording status and participant consent.
Run a 30-second local recording with host voice + Discord guest + MPC or test media, then playback for echo, clipping, and balance before flagship events.
